intro: The Mirror Lake Water Sample is a flask of fresh lake water collected from the base of the waterfall in Elwynn Forest. Gathered by novice mages on behalf of Jennea Cannon in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind, it is used to investigate whether altered arcane currents are seeping into local water supplies.

p: Following catastrophic global conflicts that tore the world's mystic channels from their stable courses, the mages of the Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind have grown deeply concerned about residual arcane disruption. Jennea Cannon tasks promising apprentices with filling a specially prepared flask at the base of the Mirror Lake waterfall, located just southwest of the Stormwind Gate. By analyzing this water sample, the mages seek to detect whether stray magical taints have seeped into the natural waterways relied upon by the surrounding populace.
